title: Rockford, IL — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Rockford, IL: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Rockford is a city in IL with a population of 147,000. Northern Illinois manufacturing hub with the Anderson Japanese Gardens and Rock Cut State Park. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
